title: Employ staff under the Live Performance Award 2020
what: Pay and employ staff at no less than the terms of the Live Performance Award 2020.

sources.title: Live Performance Award 2020
sources.quote: This industry award covers employers throughout Australia in the live performance industry and their employees in the classifications set out in this award to the exclusion of any other modern award.

reach.note: National system employers that are companies, in every state.

sources.title: Live Performance Award 2020
sources.quote: Live performance industry means: (a) producing, including pre-production and post ‑ production, staging, lighting, audio and audio/visual, presenting, performing

reach.note: Unincorporated employers outside WA (in WA they are in the state system).

sources.title: Live Performance Award 2020
sources.quote: Live performance industry means: (a) producing, including pre-production and post ‑ production, staging, lighting, audio and audio/visual, presenting, performing

sources.title: Which system of employment laws applies
sources.publisher: Government of Western Australia (Private Sector Labour Relations)
sources.quote: The state system covers: Private sector businesses and their employees that operate as: Sole traders. Partnerships, where none of the partners in the business is a constitutional corporation (trading or financial corporation).

confidence_note: Self-employed artists with no employees are not employers; the award reaches them only when they employ.
